shared_or_similar_visual_information: An inequality involving x and a cutoff value beside a piecewise formula. Compare the input condition in the lower formula label in the left image with the input condition beside the straight branch in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The linear formula applies for x at least 1, including the boundary. Right image: The straight-line formula applies only to inputs less than 1.
Rationales: The strict < sign in the right image excludes x = 1. The comparison in the left image includes equality, so its selected rule applies at x = 1.
